text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (July 8, 2024) for 177 Stephen Drive

The Property Standards Committee - Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (July 8, 2024) for 177 Stephen Drive, Folder Number 24 174950 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 5, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
